 Murusu Cyclone Effect: Schools and Colleges Closed in Several Andhra Pradesh Districts Today
 -->
 -->
 Sakshi Education 3 November 2026 -->
 Andhra Pradesh government has announced a holiday for educational institutions in several districts as Cyclone Murusu continues to influence weather conditions across the state. With widespread rainfall and forecasts of more downpours, district administrations have decided to suspend classes to prioritize the safety of students and educational staff.
 Murusu Cyclone Effect: Schools and Colleges Closed in Several Andhra Pradesh Districts Today 
 Districts Where Holiday Has Been Declared 
 Bapatla
 Nellore
 Palnadu
 Krishna
 NTR
 Eluru
 Prakasam
 Guntur
 The holiday applies to schools, colleges, and other educational institutions in these districts.
 Heavy Rain Alert 
 Several parts of the state are witnessing heavy to very heavy rainfall due to the impact of Cyclone Murusu. Authorities have advised people, especially those living in low-lying areas, to remain alert and avoid unnecessary travel. District administrations are closely monitoring the situation and have kept emergency response teams on standby.
